posts.title: Two Bikes, Many Lessons: Homage5 vs Bianchi
posts.description: Date: 20/11/2026 If you have knee, back, or heart issues I can't recommend enough an e-bike that is programmable and adjustable. posts.title: Focus on Gaining Ability more than Losing Fat
posts.description: Tags: #EbikeTraining, #AgeAndEndurance, #Sarcopenia, #TourFit2027, #DataDriven Two years ago, I learned by experience how not to lose weight. I followed a generic "calorie deficit" plan. The scale worked: the number went down. But so did my muscle mass.
